name: markdown-standards
description: Markdown authoring conventions for every Markdown file in a repo, adopted by a repository rather than enabled for an account. Covers unambiguous cross-references and link hygiene, semantic line breaks, unique cross-referenced headings, adjacent blockquotes, compact tables, the lint rules a linter bump introduces, and fixing a markdownlint or link failure at its target instead of suppressing the check. Ships reflow.py, which rewrites prose to one sentence per line, and /adopt-markdown-ci, which onboards a repo to the reusable Markdown CI in flungo/github-workflows.
